text:
mira: Quick sync: the little docs flyout in the dashboard shows 'Help drawer' in the header but links call themselves 'Docs'. We need consistent terminology and clear cross-link behavior.

jess: Accessibility first: the flyout steals focus and doesn't return it to the trigger on close. Also links inside collapsed sections aren't reachable by keyboard. I'll add aria-hidden toggles and ensure focus restoration.

dan: From infra: if we want inline anchors for glossary items, we need stable ids. Right now linker returns full URLs only. We can add an anchors map but need to coordinate with docs team.

leo: UX note: prefer 'In-product docs' as canonical label. For CTAs use 'Learn more' instead of 'Open docs'. For inline short definitions show a brief preview; for longer guides open a new tab.
docs-bot: Anchor scan: 4 top pages missing anchors. Recommend adding id attributes and updating canonical slugs.
mira: OK agreed: canonical name = 'In-product docs', CTA = 'Learn more'. Action items: jess -> a11y fixes + PR; dan -> linker mapping for anchors (fallback to full URL); leo -> update figma and microcopy; mira -> announce naming in #design and update console copy. Target: small patch next sprint.
